method: Started from the brief's list of well-known 2023-2026 CEO hires and added others found while scanning household-name companies. For each one, listed the company's filings from the EDGAR submissions API, read the Item 5.02 appointment 8-K (and offer-letter exhibit where the 8-K summary left out perks), and took first-year pay from the Summary Compensation Table (or the pay-ratio sentence quoting it) in the next proxy. Kept cases where the filings put a number on a hiring payment (sign-on cash, make-whole or inducement equity, or perks tied to the move) and a first-year SCT total exists. Executive CIKs come from the reporting-owner field of each person's first Form 4. Internal promotions, hires without a filed first-year SCT, and hires with no hiring award were rejected. Summed keys (sign_on_cash, make_whole_equity, sign_on_equity, other_perks) never overlap: a part of an award that is really annual pay uses first_annual_grant, conditional amounts use possible_extra, and caps or 'up to' allowances are replaced by the amount the next proxy's All Other Compensation table reports as actually paid. other_perks covers relocation, housing, commuting, hire-negotiation legal fees, and aircraft use only where the hiring terms grant it. All quotes were copied from the scripts/sec_text.py rendering of the cached filing.

rejected.name: Walgreens Boots Alliance (Tim Wentworth, 2023)
rejected.reason: The 8-K filed 2023-10-11 calls his $12,000,000 grant an 'initial incentive equity grant', but the proxy filed 2024-12-13 says it was his fiscal 2024 annual equity grant on the same terms as other executives. The only other hiring terms are relocation benefits, which the proxy says he did not use in fiscal 2024, and personal use of corporate aircraft up to 75 hours a year, which the proxy describes as a board security requirement it does not consider a perquisite ($179,394 in fiscal 2024). No actual sign-on payment is left.
